# #3176: Patch: follow-up to #3165 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #3165 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #3165 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42017305812)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`5a7d4be2fc56`). `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3165 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs:503`: `tally` calls `fight.kind.is_boss()`, but `RunNodeKind` has no `is_boss` method on `main`, so `jackioh-tools` (every `cargo jackioh` command) and the workspace's build, clippy and tests fail to compile at this merge commit.
  Evidence: `git grep -n is_boss HEAD` (leaving out `is_boss_card`) finds only this call. `RunNodeKind::is_boss` (`matches!(self, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss)`) was in `crates/run/src/lib.rs` at the PR's branch base f18823b01e (line 327), but fb42f52ced (#3145, #3121's dead-code sweep), which merged before this PR, deleted it as unused. The PR was built and checked against the older base, so its green gates never compiled this code with that removal. Fix: in run_sim.rs, replace the call with `matches!(fight.kind, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss)` (the meaning the tally test expects: a MiniBoss fills `boss_hp[0]`), or put the method back in `crates/run/src/lib.rs`. Then run `cargo build -p jackioh-tools`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh run_sim` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

---
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot from the after-merge spot-check (one in 5 medium or hard merges, `spot_check_every`): `claude-3` (`claude`) built #3165 and `claude-3` (`opus`) approved it. This issue's own pull request is never spot-checked.

<!-- jackioh-bot -->

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42020897581)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`main` does not compile right now. `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs:503` (`tally`) calls `RunNodeKind::is_boss`, and fb42f52ced (#3145) deleted that method. This breaks `jackioh-tools`, so every `cargo jackioh` command fails, and it also breaks the workspace build, clippy and tests. The fix replaces the call with an inline `matches!` that means the same thing: a MiniBoss or a Boss is one of a run's act bosses (spec §15.5: each act but the last ends at a mini-boss, the last at the final boss). It also adds one test that pins the Boss arm, which no test covers today. After that, every check is green.

I ran `cargo check -p jackioh-tools --all-targets` at the base (79927460d5). It reports exactly one error, E0599 `no method named is_boss found for enum RunNodeKind` at `run_sim.rs:503`, once for the bin and once for its test build. Nothing else is broken.

## Files to touch

| File | new/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs` | change | `tally`: replace `fight.kind.is_boss()` with `matches!(fight.kind, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss \| RunNodeKind::Boss)`; `mod tests`: add the test `the_tally_puts_each_mini_boss_and_the_final_boss_in_act_order` |

Do not touch:
- `crates/run/src/lib.rs`. Do not put `is_boss` back: #3121's sweep removed it on purpose.
- Any other crate or app.
- `spec/`. This change involves no ruling and no catalog change, so it needs no patch fragment and no `spec/pending` note.
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`.

Governing spec: §15.5 (`spec/15-dungeon-run.md`, the act structure). No ruling applies.

## Steps

1. In `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`, function `tally` (around line 503), change the line
   ```rust
               if fight.kind.is_boss() {
   ```
   to
   ```rust
               if matches!(fight.kind, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss) {
   ```
   `RunNodeKind` is already imported (the `use jackioh_run::{…}` at line 41). Change nothing else in `tally`.

2. In the same file's `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`, add a new `#[test]` right after `the_tally_counts_each_kind_and_prints_a_dash_for_none`, before the `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` test. It uses the module's existing `content()`, `run_setup`, `run_create` and `row` helpers, in the same pattern as the test above it:
   ```rust
       #[test]
       fn the_tally_puts_each_mini_boss_and_the_final_boss_in_act_order() {
           let content = content();
           let (setup, unlocks) = run_setup(0);
           let start = run_create(&setup, &unlocks, &content).expect("run 0 is created");
           let outcomes = [RunOutcome {
               file: RunFile {
                   setup,
                   unlocks,
                   log: Vec::new(),
               },
               end: RunState {
                   phase: RunPhase::Won,
                   ..start
               },
               fights: vec![
                   row(RunNodeKind::Fight, 30, 28, true, 8),
                   row(RunNodeKind::MiniBoss, 28, 20, true, 18),
                   row(RunNodeKind::Elite, 20, 16, true, 12),
                   row(RunNodeKind::MiniBoss, 16, 12, true, 16),
                   row(RunNodeKind::Boss, 12, 5, true, 22),
               ],
               faults: Vec::new(),
           }];
           let sums = tally(&outcomes, &content);
           assert_eq!(sums.boss_hp, [(28, 1), (16, 1), (12, 1)]);
       }
   ```
   `BOSSES` is `RUN_ACT_FIGHTS.len()`, which is 3 (`crates/run/src/config.rs:14`), so `boss_hp` is a `[(i64, usize); 3]` and the array comparison type-checks. If `cargo fmt` reflows the test, keep what it writes.

3. Run the commands under **Tests** and the checks under **Done when**.

## Tests

- `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`, `mod tests`:
  - `the_tally_puts_each_mini_boss_and_the_final_boss_in_act_order` (new). Two mini-bosses and the final boss each fill their act's `boss_hp` slot with the HP they were entered at, in order. The Fight and Elite rows fill none. The test fails if the Boss arm is dropped (it would give `(0, 0)` in slot 2), and fails if the MiniBoss arm is dropped.
  - `the_tally_counts_each_kind_and_prints_a_dash_for_none` (existing, unchanged). It still asserts that a MiniBoss fills `boss_hp[0]` and leaves `boss_hp[1]` at `(0, 0)`.

Commands:
```
cargo build -p jackioh-tools
cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh run_sim
cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
```

## Done when

- [ ] `run_sim.rs:503` no longer calls `is_boss`. `git grep -n 'is_boss()' -- crates` finds nothing.
- [ ] `cargo build -p jackioh-tools` succeeds.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh run_sim` passes, with both tally tests and the new one included and no test skipped or ignored beyond the existing daily one.
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.
- [ ] The harness's checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, the workspace clippy, the cargo tests (with no diff under `apps/web/src/wire`), and the web tests. Each red check is reported by name (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

## Risks

- **Meaning drift.** `is_boss` was exactly `matches!(self, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss)`, as shown in fb42f52ced's diff. Copy both arms. Leaving out `Boss` would quietly zero the final-boss row of the report, and the new test catches that.
- **Determinism and replay.** Not affected. `tally` only sums finished outcomes for the report and never touches a run's `rng_cursor` or log.
- **`classify --claims` / `patches check`.** The change touches only tooling code and no catalog entry, script or engine rule, so it claims nothing and needs no fragment.
- **Purity (rule 4).** Not affected: `crates/tools` is outside the pure crates.

## Open questions

None. I chose to inline `matches!` in `run_sim.rs` instead of putting `RunNodeKind::is_boss` back in `crates/run/src/lib.rs`. That keeps the fix to one file, respects #3121's dead-code sweep and leaves `jackioh-run`'s public surface as it is. A person who would rather have the method back can make that one-line change instead.

## Risks

- **Meaning drift.** `is_boss` was exactly `matches!(self, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss)`, as shown in fb42f52ced's diff. Copy both arms. Leaving out `Boss` would quietly zero the final-boss row of the report, and the new test catches that.
- **Determinism and replay.** Not affected. `tally` only sums finished outcomes for the report and never touches a run's `rng_cursor` or log.
- **`classify --claims` / `patches check`.** The change touches only tooling code and no catalog entry, script or engine rule, so it claims nothing and needs no fragment.
- **Purity (rule 4).** Not affected: `crates/tools` is outside the pure crates.
